name: manage_ledger
description: Manage ledger books, accounts, categories and budgets. A book holds its own accounts, categories and budgets and reports every total in its own currency. New books start with default categories and accounts, so create_category and create_account are only for what that set does not cover — and recording an entry under an unknown category already creates it. Budgets are monthly limits in the book's currency; a sub-category's spending counts towards its parent. Entries themselves go through ledger; display details like account type, opening balance and icons are set in the dashboard.

what.description: action=list: which to list, books by default.

name.description: The name, for the three create actions.

currency.description: create_book: the ISO code every total is reported in. create_account: only when it holds another currency.

direction.description: create_category: which tree, expense by default.

amount.description: set_budget: the monthly limit in the book's currency.

category.description: set_budget: limit this one category instead of the whole book.

book.description: Only needed when more than one exists.
